style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark rustic premium seafood visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep espresso brown-black #1A120C, gilt gold #D9A441, pale shrimp pink #F2D5C9 and seal red #B03A24; warm low-key lighting with a 3000K-3400K upper-side key, deep soft shadows and glistening highlights; one bold serif display family for gilt gold headlines with clean sans-serif labels only; solid gold circular badge icons in one flat style; dark textured ceramic tableware, dark walnut wood and indigo batik cloth surfaces; thin gold-framed inset photo panels on infographic screens; fresh loose shrimp-meat styling with stable high-angle presentation; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random bright backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon or badge styles.
noDrift: no mismatched icon or badge styles
style.presentationRules: fresh peeled shrimp meat pieces piled loosely in dark ceramic tableware, plump and glistening, no packaging; stable high-angle food styling; inset photo panels always thin gold-framed with rounded corners
